adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh flow changed from `refreshTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(responseJson)` with a `console.error(...)` on failure (and then continuing) to `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)`. The new helper throws `new Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")` when parsing fails, so invalid token responses will now abort the refresh path instead of merely logging and proceeding. This is a real, diff-grounded behavior change that may impact existing callers, though it appears intentional given the new shared helper.
